verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents its own JMAP API, with a session endpoint, API-token/OAuth auth, and the RFC 8620/8621 specs, through which an agent can query, fetch, and send mail. This gives a self-built agent a documented end-to-end connection. However, no evidence shows a ready connector for Claude or ChatGPT, and drafting and triage actions are only implied by the protocol rather than shown. missing for 10: official MCP server or first-party Claude/ChatGPT connector, explicit draft and triage (move/flag/label) documentation, hands-on corroboration of an agent workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection

citations.quote: The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
Standard OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens. No custom auth protocol to implement.
